response.overview: The gruesome death of Teacher Hassan causes villagers of Kampung Bonang to spread stories that the ghost of the deceased is seen wandering around to claim a new heir. At the same time, his daughter Julia also experiences disturbances from supernatural creatures. Meanwhile, Joey, the owner of a television programme called 'Unraveling Mysteries' is called to investigate the truth behind these events. He also convinces Lutfy, a pickle seller looking for a new job, to join him and Julia. Unfortunately, their journey to Busut is disrupted by the Guardian of Busut, causing them to get lost.
response.title: Sinopsis filem Busut Bonang
